title: Settings loader slurps the whole file before any size bound, so an oversized ~/.pp-settings.bin can OOM-crash despite the 'never a crash' contract
detail: The fixed-path dotfile is an input surface, but os.read_entire_file_from_path allocates the full file before the len(data) < 6 check; a multi-GB (or HOME-redirected) file exhausts the temp allocator and panics, contradicting the stated never-a-crash contract. Offline single-user threat model keeps this a note.
recommended_fix: Check os.file_size(path) (or read at most, say, 64 bytes) before reading; reject oversized files to defaults with the existing stderr note.
